title: Practice: Going in and going out: в- and вы-

blocks.text: Real Russian sentences that use what the lesson teaches. Type the missing word, or pick it, until it turns green.

These sentences and their English translations were written by people on Tatoeba (tatoeba.org), shared under CC BY 2.0 FR. Each blank is the word the sentence really has; the word in brackets is its dictionary form.

exercises.q: Том никогда не ___ (выходить) из дома без сопровождения телохранителей.
exercises.prompt: Tom never leaves his house without being accompanied by bodyguards.
exercises.why: «вы-»: выходить. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: У неё в одно ухо влетает, в другое ___ (вылетать).
exercises.prompt: With her, it goes in one ear and out the other.
exercises.why: «вы-»: вылетать. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).
«вы-»: выйти. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.prompt: He couldn't bear to be apart from her.
exercises.why: «вы-»: выносить. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Почувствовав, что дом сотрясается, я ___ (выбежать) наружу.
exercises.prompt: Feeling the house shake, I ran outside.
exercises.why: «вы-»: выбежать. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).
«в-»: входить. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.prompt: Take the dog for a walk.
exercises.why: «вы-»: вывести. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.prompt: We import grain from the United States.
exercises.why: «в-»: ввозить. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.prompt: A fly got into the apartment.
exercises.why: «в-»: влететь. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Том никогда не ___ (выезжать) за пределы Миннесоты.
exercises.prompt: Tom has never travelled outside the confines of Minnesota.
exercises.why: «вы-»: выезжать. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.prompt: A white ship is sailing out of the fog.
exercises.why: «вы-»: выплывать. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.prompt: We left early in the morning.
exercises.why: «вы-»: выехать. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.prompt: John came running into the room.
exercises.why: «в-»: вбежать. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).
«вы-»: вывозить. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).
